# pvecli node ssh

SSH into a Proxmox node.

```text
pvecli node ssh [NODE] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-u`, `--user VALUE` | SSH user. |
| `-P`, `--port N` | SSH port. |
| `-i`, `--key VALUE` | Path to SSH key. |
| `-c`, `--command VALUE` | Execute command instead of shell. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
